run_detection_training: run the VoteNet detection training pipeline using Hydra config and DDP across multiple GPUs
run_detection_testing: run the VoteNet detection testing pipeline using Hydra config on a single or multi-GPU setup
run_single_gpu_training: run the single_proc_run function to train a DetectionTrainer on a single GPU with a config
run_multi_gpu_training: run multi_proc_run to launch detection training across multiple GPUs with a random port
run_votenet_main: run the main entry point to start VoteNet training or testing with fixed random seeds
